title: Google plans to phase out ChromeOS by mid-2034, cutting short the 10-year support for some Chromebooks, with "many" models eligible for a Googlebook OS upgrade (Andrew E. Freedman/Tom's Hardware)
summary: Andrew E. Freedman / Tom's Hardware: Google plans to phase out ChromeOS by mid-2034, cutting short the 10-year support for some Chromebooks, with “many” models eligible for a Googlebook OS upgrade — Google is telling IT admins at schools and businesses about its new platform. … Google says it will be phasing out ChromeOS updates in mid-2034.
